title: Classify every irreducible seven-image pattern-five pool (no κ)
body:
## Result and scope

**Every complete unit-free pattern-dimension-five pool with irreducible image dimension seven has exactly seven projectors and the two-block hub-link form.** After a coordinate permutation, it consists of two disjoint normal triples and one link `(h+a)(h+b)^T`, where h is the sum of their hubs, a,b use fresh coordinates and `a dot b=1`. These conditions are also sufficient at every ambient width.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/69e70b1426c32b19da8334930815800a2c95ffca/research/no-edge-dim5-extremal-classification/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/69e70b1426c32b19da8334930815800a2c95ffca/research/no-edge-dim5-extremal-classification/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/69e70b1426c32b19da8334930815800a2c95ffca/research/no-edge-dim5-extremal-classification/verify.py) and [scope record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/69e70b1426c32b19da8334930815800a2c95ffca/research/no-edge-dim5-extremal-classification/TASK.json). This closes question 2 of [PR #7281](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7281). Prior work classified links after the two blocks were fixed. The new proof forces those blocks for an arbitrary complete pool, without assuming an irreducible image-basis subcollection. It excludes the triple-plus-quad case, every column-triple case and the zero fresh-covector boundary.

Every resulting action on the joint image is isomorphic to six coordinate projectors plus the all-one seven-by-seven matrix. The parameterization permits arbitrary fresh supports; it is not a count of coordinate-permutation orbits or a unique orbit representative. The existing positive family and its fixed-coordinate counts remain prior work.

**No new kappa**, paid BIT word, native operator or complete invoice is supplied. The selected frontier and all five assumptions remain unchanged. The missing step is now a legal word-level realization and reduction, not another scalar link search. This completes the [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19705758).

## Evidence and reproduction

Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.16 replay passed on macOS arm64. The verifier enumerates all 40768 rank-one idempotents at widths seven and eight. Three stated link domains contain 30679 candidate links and 30376 distinct unit-free spaces, with distinctness counted within each domain. Complete pools from a raw idempotent index agree with separate literal-pattern lifting. Every excluded space has a checked invariant-subspace certificate. Pools of up to ten members are included; the tests do not truncate them to seven generators.

Four triple-plus-quad fixtures cover active quad ranks two and four and both triple types. Their complete pools have seven or eight members. The normal-form lemma checks all 168 three-coordinate bases, with 18 ordered survivors. Six prior positive links at widths seven through ten pass complete-pool and all-127-vector orbit checks. The prior eight-member pool generated by `(64,69)` retains its extra member `(70,5)` and has an invariant fresh line.

The all-width reduction uses the disjoint-circuit theorem from [PR #7690](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7690), the stated finite three-coordinate normal-form lemma, and the fixed-block proof from [PR #7676](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7676). The finite link scans cover the named coordinate domains, not every ambient embedding. The complete fixed-block predecessor census was not rerun; its proof and the listed controls are reused with credit.

Metadata, committed bytes, modes, source ancestry, eight-file export and archive integrity pass. A read-only optimized export replay passes without Git or a usable PATH; all nine payload/manifest hashes and modes stay unchanged.

With CPython 3.12 and its standard library, from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/no-edge-dim5-extremal-classification/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B -O research/no-edge-dim5-extremal-classification/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/no-edge-dim5-extremal-classification
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/no-edge-dim5-extremal-classification --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers:

```text
PASS_NO_EDGE_DIM5_EXTREMAL_CLASSIFICATION
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44281041786/job/134721509980) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. Full predecessor scientific replays, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. The listed predecessor witnesses were rechecked. Independent human and formal-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Sources and credit

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Ali Romman's [PR #7690](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7690), [exact proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b725be51349cce4e0a262c76233838992042dd62/research/no-edge-total-image-bound/PROOF.md), supplies the disjoint-circuit reduction and [reused matrix/lift routines](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b725be51349cce4e0a262c76233838992042dd62/research/no-edge-total-image-bound/verify.py). Its source record retains @CubeJerry's earlier support-method credit.

@unpaidmoon supplied the normal-form lemma in [PR #6921](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6921), [exact proof](https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6020400853abc110134804fad04b695adc360bcd/research/no-edge-irreducible-image/PROOF.md), and the two-block family and question in [PR #7237](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7237) and [PR #7281](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7281), [exact source](https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0cd5324c41490b856d0e94daa8b011683fc153f6/research/no-edge-dim5-fresh-link/PROOF.md). Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the nonsymmetric link in [PR #7648](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7648), [exact source](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f967555200c111925d48a46b65b124432a762b65/research/no-edge-asymmetric-block-link/README.md), and the earlier fiber context. Ali Romman's [PR #7676](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7676), [exact proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/943c355c233649f77f018e6247e5456584ef715e/research/two-block-fresh-link-classification/PROOF.md), supplies the fixed-block complete-pool classification, restated with credit. The earlier restricted result [PR #7686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7686) and general extraction failure [PR #7688](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7688) mark the scope extended here. New work is Apache-2.0; no external runtime package is needed.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Card `bit-new-register-model`, scope changed to this scalar classification; the native construction gate remains unmet. Refreshed open/closed PR and Discussion overlap and live handoffs show the distinct predecessors and no competing full-classification claim. Sparse local and unpublished work remain coverage limits. The next useful work must state a legal paid alphabet, all counted roles, the reduction hypotheses and the complete producer/consumer invoice.
